name: x
description: A centered close mark with two balanced diagonal strokes.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: X is derived directly from the revised Plus by a 45-degree clockwise rotation about 12,12, with no rescaling. Each diagonal centerline is exactly 14 units long, sharing Plus arm length, intersections, Regular 1.70 weight and rounded end caps. The rotation is baked into the original SVG coordinates so the native Lab rotation remains 0 degrees. The diagonal projection is intentionally smaller than the unrotated Plus bounding box; there is no style-specific enlargement. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review. The owner subsequently requested a Filled-only solid rounded box with a negative-space glyph and 2-unit clearance. Outline retains this unboxed drawing; its visible Regular exterior matches the Filled glyph cutout, not the added box.
